description: Provision a Google Cloud Resourcemanager ResourceManagerPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the resourcemanager.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ResourceManagerPolicy spec.

booleanPolicy.description: A boolean policy is a constraint that is either enforced or not.

enforced.description: If true, then the Policy is enforced. If false, then any configuration is acceptable.

constraint.description: Immutable. The name of the Constraint the Policy is configuring, for example, serviceuser.services.

folderRef.description:
The folder on which to configure the constraint. Only one of
projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Folder` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

listPolicy.description: A policy that can define specific values that are allowed or denied for the given constraint. It can also be used to allow or deny all values. .

allow.description: One or the other must be set.

all.description: The policy allows or denies all values.

values.description: The policy can define specific values that are allowed or denied.

deny.description: One or the other must be set.

all.description: The policy allows or denies all values.

values.description: The policy can define specific values that are allowed or denied.

inheritFromParent.description: If set to true, the values from the effective Policy of the parent resource are inherited, meaning the values set in this Policy are added to the values inherited up the hierarchy.

suggestedValue.description: The Google Cloud Console will try to default to a configuration that matches the value specified in this field.

organizationRef.description:
The organization on which to configure the constraint. Only one of
projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of an `Organization` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description:
The project on which to configure the constraint. Only one of
projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

restorePolicy.description: A restore policy is a constraint to restore the default policy.

default.description: May only be set to true. If set, then the default Policy is restored.

version.description: Version of the Policy. Default version is 0.

title: GCP Resourcemanager ResourceManagerPolicy
